name: FFS_MESSAGE_QUEUE
description: Used to store queue of Outbound API messages that still don't have a final status.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the message in the system.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the activity the message is related to.

columns.name: VISIT_ID
columns.description: Link to FFS_VISIT record related to the message.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the related inventory ID - FFS_INVENTORY->INVENTORY_ID.

columns.name: ROUTE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique route ID -> FFS_ROUTE -> ROUTE_ID.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Link to the related resource ID - FFS_RESOURCE->RESOURCE_ID.

columns.name: SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ID of the related support request. Reference to the FFS_SERVICE_REQUEST -> SERVICE_REQUEST_ID.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Link to the related user ID - FFS_USER->USER_ID.

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: Link to the unique identifier of the notification scenario (ffs_message_flow->flow_id).

columns.name: STEP_ID
columns.description: Link to the record in FFS_MESSAGE_STEP->STEP_ID.

columns.name: PREV_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Link to the record in FFS_MESSAGE_QUEUE->MESSAGE_ID.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TRIGGER
columns.description: Trigger Label. Example: 'day_before'.

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Identifier of message method which is used to process the message..

columns.name: SUBMETHOD
columns.description: Additional identifier for message method 'external_system'.

columns.name: SEND_FROM
columns.description: Specifies starting time of the message time range for sending the message.

columns.name: SEND_TO
columns.description: Specifies ending time of the message time range for sending the message.

columns.name: GMT_SHIFT
columns.description: Time Zone Difference. Value in Minutes.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Notification Status. Values: 'new', 'sending', 'failed', 'sent', 'delivered', 'falsemethod', 'obsolete'.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Extended notification status description.

columns.name: DATA
columns.description: Information delivered from external system(customer wants to change phone to #).

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: Sent message external system identifier.

columns.name: FAULT_RETRIES
columns.description: Total attempts quantity on notification sent failure.

columns.name: FAULT_ATTEMPT
columns.description: Rest of attempts quantity on notification sent failure.

columns.name: FAULT_INTERVAL
columns.description: Interval before next notification attempt on notification sent failure.

columns.name: SENT_ATTEMPT
columns.description: Rest of attempts quantity on notification sent.

columns.name: SENT_INTERVAL
columns.description: Interval before next notification attempt on notification sent.

columns.name: SENT
columns.description: Notification message Sent Time.

columns.name: TIME_DELIVERED_START
columns.description: Specifies the activity communicated window time start.

columns.name: TIME_DELIVERED_END
columns.description: Specifies the activity communicated window time end.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Step Duration Time. Calculated value.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Notification Message Creation Date and Time.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Notification Message Last Update Time.

columns.name: STOPPED
columns.description: It's a bitmap mask which identifies message's further steps.

columns.name: SURVEY_ID
columns.description: This field is not used and can be removed.

columns.name: PREV_STATUS
columns.description: Previous message's notification status.

columns.name: PREV_DESC
columns.description: Previous message's extended notification status description.

columns.name: PREV_DATA
columns.description: Previous message's information delivered from external system(customer wants to change phone to #).

columns.name: PREV_SUBJECT
columns.description: Previous message's information delivered from external system(customer wants to change phone to #).

columns.name: PREV_BODY
columns.description: Previous message's information delivered from external system(customer wants to change phone to #).

columns.name: PREV_STOPPED
columns.description: Previous Notification Message's Option(s).

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Notification Address which was used for the action.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
